title: State of the Art in Fair ML: From Moral Philosophy and Legislation to Fair Classifiers
reasoning: The paper dedicates a substantial portion of its content (specifically Chapter 2) to exploring the moral philosophy foundations of fairness, including a detailed discussion of John Rawls' Theory of Justice as Fairness and various notions of Equality of Opportunity. This ethical framework serves as the basis for the machine learning fairness criteria discussed later in the text.
